name: Valentyne Stories: Necromancy
source:
« Magic is a gift, given to only a few chosen ones in the world. Be it the heir of a rich family or the offspring of the least good for nothing, every son able to use magic is promised to a great future. If he's prone to use his gift for the kingdom, his name will be known in Arcan's History, bringing honour and glory even to his first ancestors. »

After hearing these quite sententious words, Rave left his comfortable town to become a great Mage. New to the Academy, which exists to teach the magic elite, the young man came to learn, to become « someone », to make his family proud. Improving himself  and avoiding being scolded by his teachers should have been his only concerns for the next three years. 

Should have. 

Unluckily, Rave happens to be in a bad place, at the worst time.

From the student sleeping in the bed next to his to the guard watching over him, everyone is tense in the school. Something is coming, something that will more likely change their whole world, where everyone gets a part to play.

Rave will have to discover what's going on, pick a side, and who to brave.

[From [url=http://valentyne-stories-necromancy.com/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
“魔法是一份礼物，只有世界上少数被选中的人才能得到。无论是富裕家族的继承人，还是最没用之人的后代，只要是能够使用魔法的男孩，就注定拥有光明的未来。如果他愿意为王国运用这份天赋，他的名字便会载入阿尔坎的历史，为祖先带来荣耀与光辉。”

听过这番颇为说教的话后，Rave离开舒适的小镇，立志成为伟大的法师。刚进入培养魔法精英的学院，他来到这里学习，努力成为“某个大人物”，让家人感到自豪。接下来的三年里，他本该只需提升自己，避免受到老师责骂。

本该如此。

可惜，Rave偏偏在最糟糕的时刻，身处最糟糕的地方。

从睡在他隔壁床上的学生，到负责看守他的警卫，学校里的每个人都神经紧绷。某种东西正在逼近，它很可能改变整个世界，而每个人都将扮演属于自己的角色。

Rave必须查明真相，选择阵营，并决定该勇敢面对谁。
